items.followUp: State two roles of mitosis in living organisms.

rubric.why: Mitosis increases cell number and supports the growth of an organism.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying growth as a significance of mitosis.

rubric.why: Mitosis replaces damaged cells and helps repair tissues.
rubric.description: States that mitosis repairs tissues by replacing damaged cells.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying tissue repair or replacement of damaged cells.

modelAnswer: Mitosis increases the number of cells, allowing an organism to grow.
It repairs tissues by replacing damaged cells.

items.followUp: Write two more characteristics of enzymes.

rubric.why: Enzymes act as biological catalysts and speed up chemical reactions.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that enzymes are biological catalysts or that they speed up chemical reactions.

rubric.why: Each enzyme acts on a particular substrate.
rubric.description: States that enzymes are specific to their substrates.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that an enzyme acts on a particular substrate.

modelAnswer: Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed up chemical reactions.
Each enzyme is specific to a particular substrate.
